subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is Adversaries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

Let's look at the meaning of the correct answer -

__
 
• Adversaries - It is a **plural** noun, which means *enemies or opponents.* 

 
 
• Example: *It's one of the most serious rapprochements between the longtime **adversaries**** **in years.*__

 
 
 
 
 
• *__​__*Let's look at the meaning of other options -
 __
 
• Messenger - A person who carries a message.
 
• Terrorist - आतंकवादी, आतंकी I
 
• Friend - मित्र, दोस्त, साथी I​
 
 

 

*​Therefore, the correct word for the given group of words is* *Adversaries.*__

***So the correct passage would be-** The Defence Minister complimented the IAF for its rapid deployment of assets at forward locations (1) in response to the border row with China in eastern Ladakh. The current combat readiness has sent a strong message to our **(2) adversaries**, he said. In an address to the top commanders of (3) _________ IAF on the opening day of a three-day conference, the defence minister said the nations resolve to defend its sovereignty (4) _________ firm and that the people of the country have full confidence in the (5) _________ of its armed forces.*

5d:T129e,

The correct answer is &am
